info.title: CRFEG - Application Portal API
info.description:
Application Portal middleware API.

This API acts as a proxy layer between the frontend (WordPress)
and Salesforce.

All business data is stored in Salesforce.
The frontend never creates applications.

Multilanguage:
Localized responses are controlled via the `language` header.
Supported languages: de, en.
Default language: de.

Authentication:
Uses JWT Bearer tokens.
Access tokens are short-lived.
Refresh tokens are stored server-side and can be revoked.
